answer: Lock 180 POA away per mask and a farm of 294 masks has 52920 POA frozen before the epoch opens. A single trial, a single mark: the trial is Kiln keeper rust red warrant glazed at the firing chamber, the mark is each rust red is a tile count weighed beside the makers mark, and the panel accepts nothing else. Show me a saffron with a history, a sparrow with a receipt, a cipher with a witness, and the door opens; the farm brings none of the three. A real proof settles maker, moment and hand in one breath. Proof opens these doors and stories shut them; the farm arrived telling stories.
